problem_text: 已知多項式$Q\left( x \right)=ax+b$，$f\left( x \right)=\left( 2a-b \right){{x}^{2}}+ax-1$，$g\left( x \right)=3{{x}^{2}}+x-1$，且$f\left( x \right)=g\left( x \right)$。若分式方程式$\frac{x}{Q(x)}+\frac{5}{x-2}=\frac{-1}{(x-2)\text{ }Q(x)}$的解為$x=c$，則${{a}^{2}}+{{b}^{2}}+{{c}^{2}}=$？ (A)3 (B)10 (C)18 (D)27 〔112統測B〕
detailed_solution: KEY(1) $f\left( x \right)=a{{x}^{2}}+bx+c$，$g\left( x \right)=k{{x}^{2}}+mx+n$若$f\left( x \right)=g\left( x \right)$ $a=k$，$b=m$，$c=n$(2) 兩分式的加減：$\frac{A}{B}\pm \frac{C}{D}=\frac{AD+BC}{BD}$
